title: Metric, Scale, Containment & Orientation Transform Runtime
objective: Implement metric transforms; recursive/nested/bigger-inside containment transforms; scale relationships; orientation/gravity frames; entry/exit transform semantics; movement/range/projectile/scene adapters; identity-preserving nesting; and the owner-approved isometry/frame-transport plus continuous-geometry/discrete-substrate equivalence semantics.
acceptance: Metric transforms explicitly define distance/range semantics without conflating topology.
Recursive/nested/bigger-inside containment preserves canonical identity across containment depth.
Scale relationships are explicit and compose deterministically with metric/containment rules.
Orientation/gravity frames and entry/exit frame transport are explicit runtime state.
Isometries/frame transport may return to the same canonical location with a different local frame when the authored law permits it.
Continuous geometry and discrete traversal substrates can prove equivalent realization of the same accepted spatial law.
Movement, range, projectile and scene adapters consume the same accepted law semantics.
Blocking transform workflows remain semantic/nonvisual, keyboard-capable, provider-off and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSLR-01/03/04/07 and upstream completed programs remain sealed.
Topology remains distinct from metric geometry.
MCS remains projection authority; projected coordinates are not intrinsic metric truth.
GPR/Action/Event retain generic execution and immutable Event history.
MSLR-13 and later tranches remain unauthorized until MSLR-08 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for metric/scale/containment/orientation transforms, frame transport, continuous/discrete law equivalence, identity-preserving nesting and shared movement/range/projectile/scene adapters.
